title: Hissing Volcanic Vent
description: A jagged crack in the earth spews columns of superheated gas and acrid sulfurous fumes that sting the eyes and throat. Yellow mineral crusts have built up around the vent's lip, and scattered coins from unlucky travelers glint in the haze. The ground trembles with each violent exhalation.

choices.label: Collect sulfite deposits
choices.description: Scrape the crystallized sulfite growths from around the vent.

outcomes.text: The sulfite crystals snap free in thick clusters, their acrid smell making your eyes water but filling your pouch with valuable reagent.
Only a few deposits are worth harvesting. The rest have been corroded by the constant fumes.
A violent eruption of gas blasts from the vent as you reach for the crystals. Searing fumes engulf your outstretched arm.

choices.label: Harvest the mineral crust
choices.description: Chip away the ember-rich mineral deposits ringing the opening.

outcomes.text: The mineral crust crumbles into heaps of ember dust as you chip it free. Rich deposits, easily gathered.
Thin deposits yield a modest amount of dust, mixed with sulfur and ash.
The vent belches a cloud of choking sulfur. Your party staggers back, eyes streaming and lungs burning.

choices.label: Brave the heat for coins
choices.description: Dash through the fumes to grab the scattered coins near the vent.

outcomes.text: You hold your breath and sprint. Coins clatter into your pouch as you scoop them up. You make it back before the next gas blast.
You grab a handful of coins but the heat forces a quick retreat. The fumes leave you gasping.
The vent erupts the moment you reach the coins. Superheated gas sears exposed skin and the blast knocks you backward.
